description: StratProof runs honest backtests: real fees, real slippage, walk-forward validation. Six public tools, no OAuth. Call prove_strategy to test any strategy description ("Buy ETH when RSI(7) below 25, exit on 1.5% gain") and get a CONFIRMED / MIXED / DEBUNKED verdict with diagnosis. Call get_live_proof to see how our adaptive engine is actually performing in paper trading right now. Data sources: Binance spot (3 years), aggregated research output from 7,000+ tested candidates.
